verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills framework and plugin for coding agents, so an official SDK for building against it is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no official SDK or programmatic library. The porting guide for new harnesses, the internal Python eval harness, and the markdown skill folders are integration or testing internals, not SDKs for users to build against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
